decisions.reason: Removing a burden is a complete general-language meaning related to rid; retain the transitive restriction without inventing register guidance.
Making someone discontent or bad-tempered fits workplace dissatisfaction, without requiring resentment in every occurrence.
No exact evidence supports the joined spelling or the claimed formal-register distinction; a sourced spaced-phrase identity is needed.
Depriving someone of an illusion is explicit and related to discovering a disappointing truth; no generic disappointment equivalence is approved.
The joined form lacks exact factual evidence; do not fabricate a phrasal-verb entry from the old dump gloss.
The lengthy analytical discourse meaning directly supports academic dissertation and treatise vocabulary.
The source explicitly supplies the understandable synonym differently; the old requirement for a particularly strong contrast is not retained.
The adjective's capability-of-being-dissolved meaning supports soluble in science; the unrelated tobacco-product noun is excluded.
The explicit liquid-that-dissolves-other-substances sense matches solvent and avoids the ambiguous dissolved-versus-dissolving Wiktionary noun.
The condensed liquid from distillation is an explicit chemistry meaning; it is not substituted for a general financial fraction.
A wholesale-distribution business is relevant to commercial vocabulary; territorial exclusivity is not implied by the source.
The candidate matching hesitation only repeats dither, while WordNet defines image processing; neither supplies a self-contained verified intended meaning.
The available musical composition sense is not supported by the business or travel suite anchors; this specialist connection confuses homonyms.
Disclosing secret or private information is self-contained and relevant to business confidentiality; no intention requirement is added.
The malformed accented-word spelling has no exact entry; the French dining suggestion does not establish an English source identity.
The document-derived adjective is verified for the exact headword and relevant to office records; it is not a film-genre replacement.
Select the clothing verb supported by wear and dress, not the unrelated professor, title, river or crime-boss senses; special clothing is not required.
The existing corrected headword still lacks exact cached sense evidence; retain the correction but do not publish based solely on the old look-alike gloss.
The source explains douses as extinguishes, especially with water, making a complete equipment-related meaning without requiring small outdoor flames.
The heavy-load horse-drawn cart meaning supports transport vocabulary; retain its historical label rather than presenting it as modern generic equipment.
The labour meanings are verified but the sole fitness hack anchor confuses a workout term with a person doing menial work.
The botanical fruit classification is not established as useful by the fitness almond anchor; avoid promoting specialist taxonomy through a food-name match alone.
A device reproducing documents or discs is explicit and relevant to office equipment; no mandatory high-volume or historical distinction is added.
The specified hard-kernel wheat used for bread and pasta is appropriate to agriculture and commodity vocabulary linked to wheat.
A pair of elements treated as one is understandable and supports couple in general and academic reading; specialist musical and tensor senses remain unselected.
A distance traveled eastward is an explicit extension of east; it denotes distance rather than the direction alone.
The intellectual and stylistic senses do not justify the sole financial diversification connection; an appropriate learning context remains unresolved.
An economist using statistical and mathematical methods is a self-contained occupational meaning matching the economist anchors.
The branch of economics applying statistics to theories and relationships fits economic data study; retain uncountable usage.
The snake-family taxonomy is unrelated to the fitness cobra-pose anchor; verified zoology alone does not make that learning connection appropriate.
The polymer with rubber-like elastic properties supports industrial materials vocabulary anchored to rubber, without equating every rubber product with a material class.
No exact extracted sense supports this plural record; neither age nor wisdom and authority should be inferred from the old elderly gloss.
Campaigning for elective office is explicit and supports the political sense of campaign; retain uncountable usage.
No exact source sense is available for this plural; a verified elector morphology mapping is needed before meaning-based release.
Powered by electricity is a complete equipment meaning; it does not entail deliberately charged or dangerous surfaces in every use.
The sole definition depends on unexplained electrotechnology and does not establish equivalence to electrician; clearer factual occupational evidence is needed.
Leaving out or omitting something is clear and relevant to written communication; phonetic deletion and conflation are separate senses.
The generic agent-that-eliminates entries are circular and do not verify the intended tournament-match sense proposed by preliminary.
The act of lengthening is explicit and related to stretching; no specific one-axis strain formula is inferred.
Explanatory and clarifying provide a self-contained meaning relevant to explanations; no example is invented to unlock practice.
